faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulmueed?
faq.a: Abdulmueed is associated with Arabic. Abdulmueed is Arabic عَبْدُ الْمُعِيد (ʿAbd al-Muʿīd), meaning 'servant of the Restorer'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْمُعِيد is Arabic.
